title: Tensor.fill_diagonal_ doesn't support dynamic shapes
bug_description:
repro:
```
import torch

@torch.compile(dynamic=True)
def f(x):
    x.fill_diagonal_(True)

x = torch.zeros(4, 4)
f(x)
```

error:
```
torch._dynamo.exc.TorchRuntimeError: Dynamo failed to run FX node with fake tensors: call_method fill_diagonal_(*(FakeTensor(..., size=(4, 4)), True), **{}): got RuntimeError('Cannot call storage_offset() on tensor with symbolic sizes/strides\nException raised from throw_cannot_call_with_symbolic
```
